newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: INSIGHT - DUTCH CHARTISTS SEE MORE RECORDS FOR AEX.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - DUTCH CHARTISTS SEE MORE RECORDS FOR AEX.

text.p: Dutch chartists on Monday
remain positive as to the direction of the AEX share index with
first resistance expected at around 598, and scope for even more
upward potential.
"Eventually the target remains at 625-630," said IRIS.
The index slipped just under 594 points (down 0.37) in late
afternoon on Monday, after lingering in positive territory for
most of the day.
Last week the index rose 7.13 to close at a new record of
594.33 points on Friday.
Later on Friday, stocks in the U.S. broke a new record when
the Dow Jones closed about 35 points higher at 6094.23.
"Buying activity remains strong", said ING, adding current
healthy technicals show the bull run still has some power left.

Note - Contributors' own analysis follows.
ABN AMRO - The scenario we layed down over a month ago, in
which we described that 603 is the first target for the AEX, is
almost reached. After this target, we expect prices to
consolidate above 600 for a short while and to test 600 as new
support. If this test holds we set our minds to the new target
of 630. However, be warned for developing negative divergence
which forms a warning. The overbought readings in the current
market situation are not alarming yet, but maintain close
trailing exit-stops to be safe from down swings. Take notice
that the most volatile up moves occur on overbought areas.
ING Barings - The AEX is continuing its upward path, making
new highs. The uptrend offers first support at 585. Intermediate
support at the level of its 9-day moving average around 589.
Recent downturn in fast momentum may indicate a correction,
which will be limited as long as the rising trend channel is
intact. Money flows of the AEX remain strong, which indicates
that there is still liquidity pouring into the market. It also
confirms that buying activity remains strong. Current healthy
technicals show that the bull run still has some power left.
Short term objective lies at 600. Long term target remains
unchanged at 630.
IRIS - The bullish outlook for the AEX index remains intact.
This week a challenge of the psychological barrier at 600 may be
expected. Eventually the target remains at 625-630.
Fibonacci Press - The intermediate term trend is still up
with resistance around 632. The short term trend remains in a
remarkably lengthy topping process, showing only very moderate
setbacks. The upside potential is however limited and we expect
to see some reaction from higher levels. Resistance at 598 and
604. Re-accumulation in the expected weakness is advised as long
as not below 580.
